description: This file defines a UserInfo class used in the authentication endpoints of the PublicApi project, representing user information and authentication state.

classes.name: UserInfo
classes.description: Represents user information in authentication context, including claims and authentication status.

methods.name: UserInfo.Anonymous
methods.description: A static readonly instance representing an anonymous or unauthenticated user.

methods.name: UserInfo.IsAuthenticated
methods.description: Indicates whether the user is authenticated.

methods.name: UserInfo.NameClaimType
methods.description: The claim type used for the user's name.

methods.name: UserInfo.RoleClaimType
methods.description: The claim type used for the user's role.

methods.name: UserInfo.Claims
methods.description: A collection of claim values associated with the user.
